title: IBM Cloud for Government (IC4G) Rev5 Secure Configuration Guidance
introduction: This document provides security configuration guidance for IBM Cloud for Government (IC4G) services aligned with FedRAMP Revision 5 Recommended Secure Configuration (FRR-RSC) requirements. This page contains FedRAMP specific guidance for IC4G services. This guidance is a point in time reference to how to configure IC4G services and top-level administration accounts in a secure fashion.
